title: One Pawn, One Move
setup: Black has a king on h8 and a pawn on a5, and once the king's squares are taken, that pawn is the only thing left that can move.
hint: Count Black's legal moves. When the number is one, you only have to survive it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qf7}} seals g8 and h7 without giving check. Black must push with {{a4}}, and {{Qg8#}} is mate with the bishop covering. Take the squares first and let the pawn walk into the mate on its own.
